hectorlee-volume-price-screener v0.1.0

- Initial release of 纯量价关系A股选股系统 V3.5, supporting 6 major volume-price patterns (D/E/C/B/A/R)
- Features multi-factor fusion, multi-period confirmation, industry resonance analysis, and real-time exposure tracking
- Covers entire A股 market, including 科创板/北交所, with 7× daily automatic scanning
- Implements robust risk filters (ST, delisting, 一字板, 连板, etc.) and a comprehensive 135-point scoring system
- Provides command-line tools for market scanning, intraday monitoring, single stock diagnostics, and position-level risk analysis
- Includes historical signal tracking and detailed module/touchpoint documentation
